archive_method: 读取当前报告、修正审计和关键结果JSON；本次未运行模型、环境、API，也未重复计算文件散列。不是原始实验的全量重新审计。
precedence: 用户优先级停止记录优先于仍写运行中的旧HTML段落
修正前提规范及专项修正审计优先于旧论文/manifest继承metrics
已完成独立分析优先于普通状态摘要；中断与未执行不得计失败

global_verdict.go: 可引用模型特定隔离审计、受限预测误差、正常能力、真实但条件性的任务变化及负结果。
global_verdict.no_go: 尚无真实预训练World Model＋Agent上稳定、可归因、有有效防御并独立泛化的完整普适安全证据链，投稿目标未完成。Cosmos已有一个内部Future-Goal改选与真实失败相联的开发初态，首块作用获缓存回放支持；不能把这一局部证据升级为普适Goal-Bus物理污染或成熟攻击防御机制。
global_verdict.reason: 保留所有局部真实损害和缓解；当前缺口是现实接口、选择性因果解释、强对照下的稳定性与独立泛化没有在同一主张上闭合。预测差异本身仍不等于误差或动作效用损失。

evidence_strength_dimensions.normal_baseline: WorldAgen21/30、Cosmos29/30、DINO2/3已测；AlphaBrain修正后单例1/1，扩展OOM零完成；JEPA reach-wall不完整。
evidence_strength_dimensions.real_task_harm: 不同条件下已测局部损害须分开：缩小CEM的CartPole、TD-MPC2 source23负迁移、Cosmos单例，以及DINO原生seed4累计回报下降10.775%。DINO并未修改Goal，且成功相关指标改善；这些不是同一机制的普适攻击证据。
evidence_strength_dimensions.causal_mechanism: WorldAgen特定文本依赖/切断可测，稳定任务损害未建立。DINO受限请求改写的配对效用与恢复成立，但平均固定动作前缀误差降低，完整候选排名及长时域误差中介未测；旧bank目标失配不能唯一解释新闭环效应。TD-MPC2负迁移未与源状态覆盖分离。 新TD-MPC2冻结头损失控制显示差额对更新方式敏感，但random退化导致选择性恢复门未过。
evidence_strength_dimensions.defense: CartPole完整bank平均有局部缓解；Cosmos普通表示规范化有恢复；DINO可信当前候选绑定精确恢复Clean回报及99步轨迹。这些尚非具有独立泛化证据的新防御；Bus-Cut预测恒等仍不是Goal-Bus任务恢复。
evidence_strength_dimensions.independent_generalization: 单episode相关预测样本、小开发面板与同场景第二任务均不能替代独立泛化。

entries.title: Goal 不变性前提
entries.why: 完整环境的干预不变性与部分观测模型的条件预测不变性是不同命题。
may_cite: 固定完整增广状态、覆盖预测时域的已执行低层动作、外生噪声，且 Goal 仅为偏好时，真实物理后果不变。
WorldAgen 官方 task-agnostic world-head/隔离 mask 承诺提供模型特定的实现审计依据；论文部分文字存在不一致，须引用具体公式与 mask。
相同物理未来可以有不同的任务条件潜坐标；必须比较共同物理量或经独立验证的对齐输出。
must_not_cite: 从环境端不变直接推出 P(Y|O,A,G) 对 Goal 不变。
把 WorldAgen 隔离契约推广为 AlphaBrain/Cosmos 的设计要求。
把固定噪声下单次输出差异直接等同于随机分布变化或攻击成功。
直接把不同任务的latent差异、混合任务接口失配或Goal可见像素变化当物理预测错误。

entries.title: WorldAgen 正确编码的同场景预测

单轨迹上的指令依赖与误差变化。
must_not_cite: 把6个相关转移或12次回放当独立episode。
总体显著性、训练分布观测充分性、普遍污染、稳定任务损害或有效任务防御。

entries.title: Cosmos 原生 N2 Goal-Swap
entries.why: 30对完整回合仅损失1个成功，未达到原定至少3例/2任务跟进门。
may_cite: 固定循环干预Clean29/30→Swap28/30；保留单一真实损失及No-Go。
第一查询固定状态/候选翻转3/30；共同前缀任意翻转22/30是有截尾描述。
完整30行联表：3次首选择翻转；已有真实候选回放支持task3/init2从首块选1后170步成功，变为选0后原Goal正常续接300步失败。首块改变足以产生该例损失；没有新增单次Swap回合。
已知task3/init2固定两候选真值补测：原评分选1、Swap选0、真值替换选1；两候选视觉特征预测MSE分别增为10.37和9.50倍。完整续接效用复用原环境分支，不是新恢复回合。
完整冻结3×3输出来源矩阵支持已知单例的视觉槽条件因果作用：三种proprio背景下Swap视觉都选失败候选，Clean/真实视觉都选成功候选；18次Value，三对角完整张量精确复现，无新真实回合。
must_not_cite: 稳定决策损害、外部低权限写接口、普遍Goal不变性、已验证Bus-Cut/Control-Cut恢复。
将22/30报告为无截尾逐query攻击率。
把派生单次选择效用说成新运行的one-shot Goal-Swap，或声称首选择完全中介持续Swap、后续Swap无作用。
将事后单例真值替换称为可部署Bus-Cut、独立样本或一般攻击率；把latent MSE称完整物理误差。
将混合表示的选择恢复称可部署防御、物理场景语义完全中介、proprio无影响、独立泛化或9个独立任务；以此推翻旧文本入口和30根扩展的负结果。

first_choice_identifiability_bounds.scope: Existing30-root two-first-candidate real continuations; fixed later original-Goal native policy and seeds.

conditional_uniform_k4.baseline: New independent uniform scorer on same fixed bank; not native fixedseed31/32.

first_choice_identifiability_bounds.decision: Do not generate480 forecast/value calls to expand this first-choice-only bank as a large binary-harm study. The native>=3losses/atleast2tasks gate is mathematically unreachable on these branches. Local/cost sensitivity is not ruled out but is not a new accepted mechanism.
first_choice_identifiability_bounds.limits: Conditional finite-cache mathematical bounds, not new attack evidence, attainable attack claims, single-draw guarantees, population bounds, or exclusions of later interventions.

first_query_truth_countercheck.scope: One post-hoc known harmful task3/init2; new exact16-control prefix replays and calibrated model regeneration, with historical original-Goal full-continuation utilities. Not a new attack panel or full recovery episode.
first_query_truth_countercheck.conclusion: Local future-conditioned ranking effect is supported: Swap errors rise on both candidates, ranking reverses, and actual-future substitution restores the successful candidate ranking. Does not exclude off-truth Value errors or establish full mediation, defense, permission boundary or generalization.
first_query_truth_countercheck.expansion_gate: Original30-root >=3 losses / >=2tasks gate remains failed; no relabeling of known root as independent evidence.

future_output_factorial.interpretation: At the fixed known harmful root, changing only visual output slots is sufficient to reverse the fixed-seed native Value ranking in both Clean/Swap directions; Clean and true visual blocks also recover the historically successful candidate while holding Swap proprio. Proprio still changes scores and margins; it is not numerically irrelevant.
future_output_factorial.limits: Researcher-created mixed representations may not describe a coherent physical scene. This is conditional Value-input dependence, not a physical mediation percentage, deployable defense, new ASR or internal Goal-entry localization. Real continuation utility is reused, not rerun.
future_output_factorial.next_action: Close this full matrix without camera/slot/seed/root search. Keep all previous failed route, coupling and30-root expansion gates.

resource_gate.meaning: Resource allocation only, not statistical confirmation. Cost gains cannot rescue a failed success gate.

may_cite: native/fixed0/fixed1/uniform均29/30；真实两候选回放支持首次排序无净成功收益。

entries.title: CartPole 逐候选分布保持的排序耦合：局部真实危害与采样缓解
entries.why: 局部真实回报损失和bank-mean缓解应保留；强CEM、独立训练和真实预训练TD-MPC2对照未形成稳健、可推广的安全证据链。

cartpole.model: 本地3000条随机真实转移训练的五成员GaussianMLP；冻结后评估
cartpole.interface: 研究者添加的sampler-supply-chain hook；保留原生ModelEnv与缩小CEM

bank_mean_mitigation.operation: 使用8批共80粒子的平均；原对照/攻击仅向CEM返回一批10粒子估计
bank_mean_mitigation.scope: 真实已测局部缓解；未测试攻击一个新的80粒子采样器，非认证防御，服务暴露完整bank的权限另需说明。

strong_native_cem.settings: 350 candidates, 5 iterations, 20 particles, horizon15, elite-mean output

pretrained_tdmpc2.interface: 终端Q双头抽样，非随机动力学预测

worldmind_separate_family_boundary.scope: 独立机制家族的固定host错误/检索适配单实例；非rank-coupling迁移实验，不能与CartPole或TD-MPC2合并。

may_cite: 在一个固定学习型CartPole模型和缩小CEM上，跨候选联合抽样改变可保持每个候选完整预测批次边缘分布，却在4个配对回合造成真实回报下降；汇总含2个发现seed和2个后续seed。
已有逐候选分布保持的解析构造与局部真实危害；它们不是普通观测OOD或已证明的实现错误。
同模型生成预算下使用完整bank平均，后续两seed达到200上限；须同时披露改变CEM获得的信息与聚合方式。
强规划器及其他任务的反证与正结果同时引用；WorldMind的clean/proper/bypass均成功，只能说明该独立适配检查未转移出任务危害。
must_not_cite: 局部CartPole结果作为真实发布预训练WM+Agent的普适漏洞、合法动作即可实现的攻击或部署低权限漏洞。
将逐候选边缘分布保持说成联合分布保持、对真实环境预测正确，或推成渐近不可修复。
将bank-mean写成已认证安全、被攻击80粒子服务的防御或不增加信息访问的通用修复。
把TD-MPC2不足1分回报差称有意义损害；隐去强CEM200/200、独立训练仅1/2下降和Reacher改善。
把WorldMind单实例4/12/7步差异当可重复成本攻击或与rank-coupling同机制泛化。
把已被common-random-numbers/WorldKernel等先例覆盖的广义联合依赖问题直接称新颖机制。
SafeDreamer共享噪声导致动作变化不等于安全模式中介或真实损害；冻结实例462/449均在奖励分支且未执行物理动作，不扩展为ASR或泛化结论。

historical_consumer_resource_followup.scope: Fixed first-query final-CEM safety-mode mediator test of existing sampling family; source/checkpoint/core runtime available, exact official environment installation incomplete. Zero model or environment execution.

new_consumer_result_followup.scope: One frozen first-query final-CEM intervention on the official pretrained OSRP model. Exact independent calibration; native/common safe counts462/449, both reward mode; zero actual actions. This is a fixed reachability null, not task safety or universal impossibility.
new_consumer_result_followup.decision: No query/root/seed/threshold/horizon/coupling search or physical expansion after the frozen null.

entries.title: Cosmos预训练预测经验bank耦合：严格分离的负结果
entries.why: 资格化预训练随机Future→Value与真实候选续接后，K8 bank中成功候选最低分仍高于失败候选最高分；改变配对无法改变选择。不是只因缺载体而关闭，也不是新物理任务试验。

metrics.carrier_qualification: Existing calibrated released Cosmos Future/Value calls, fixed action pair, true-future countercheck and real continuation utilities satisfied the archived matched-pretrained-carrier condition for this single bounded pilot; this is not a new conceptual mechanism.
metrics.native_vs_added: Use released pretrained Cosmos Future and Value functions. Keeping the two existing actions and Value seeds fixed while drawing new Future seeds defines an ADDED finite-bank query protocol. Native best_of_n shares each candidate seed across Action/Future/Value; its original joint law is NOT preserved by this protocol.
metrics.operation: Only pair fixed bank rows with a bijection before a fresh uniform row draw; keep every candidate empirical forecast marginal, weights, Goal, action and scorer fixed. Score/utility-informed optimal pairing is an oracle feasibility bound.
limits: Bounds cover this observed K8 empirical bank, not full diffusion support or the original native cross-stage seed law.
Historical real continuation outcomes supply the utilities; no new physical episode, recovery or success-rate experiment was executed.
One posthoc root; 16 samples and 64 pairs are not independent task replications.
Does not negate prior CartPole harm or the separate Cosmos Goal-Swap case; no ASR, generalization, effective defense or qualified core claim.
metrics.decision: Stop this bank after the frozen scientific null. No new seeds, roots, candidate expansion, Value/denoising changes or full closed-loop panel to seek an effect.

may_cite: 在这个固定经验bank上，64种配对无并列且均选择历史成功候选；所有保均匀边缘耦合坏动作概率严格为0。
原生预训练Future/Value函数可复用，但独立Future seed bank是新增采样协议，不能声称保持原生Action/Future/Value共seed联合分布。
这是带原生函数精确校准与既有真实效用来源的限定负结果，冻结门未过并按协议停止。
must_not_cite: 完整扩散分布或任意seed/candidate/Value条件下的采样安全证明。
64个独立任务、实测新回合成功率100%、新Goal-Swap攻击或防御恢复。
推翻已有局部CartPole真实损害或Cosmos原Goal-Swap已知失败；声称一般无耦合漏洞或已完成核心安全研究。

entries.title: TD-MPC2 合法源经验的条件性任务损失
entries.why: source23下真实负迁移成立；源状态覆盖、普通负迁移与候选机制未被分离。
may_cite: source23的两个walker-run完整回合相对random下降19.09%/19.34%，相对shuffle下降19.31%/18.21%；一步latent MSE为random的0.9225。
dyn-only是明确重建的consistency-loss继续训练；原生model.next与MPC保留。
must_not_cite: 统一动作顺序漏洞、稳定跨来源/跨任务攻击、非正规Jacobian因果机制、有效通用防御。
把动作多重集相同当完整转移数据多重集相同；reverse/shuffle重新运行环境，状态覆盖不同。

utility_timing_decomposition.scope: Post hoc arithmetic on one fixed reach-v3/reward-v2 native pair; no new trajectories or forecast calls.

first_query_fixed_two_mean_ranking.scope: One shared initial context, original goal and two post-hoc selected full native returned means. Fixed native terminal objective on cached forecasts; real utility from each existing15-control prefix. Not the complete CEM bank or a new trajectory experiment.

first_query_full_horizon_truth.limits: Fixed two-mean open-loop bank on one known root; native executes15 then replans. Not full CEM-population mediation, success-rate loss, Goal-Swap, independent generalization or training-support proof. Error direction may still mediate selection; no claim that all forecast-error effects are excluded.
first_query_full_horizon_truth.decision: Retain local representation-to-selection effect and measured physical loss; reject prediction-degradation attribution on this bank. Do not expand this construct without a distinct mechanism.
